Speeded Categorization Experiments

Preprocessing

sc <- sc %>% 
  separate(col = ConcValCombo, into = c("TruthCond", "Valence"), sep = "\\-")
agr <- sc %>% 
  group_by(TruthCondFoil,Task,Valence) %>% 
  summarize(MeanRT = mean(ReactionTime),
            SD = sd(ReactionTime),
            MeanLogRT = mean(LogReactionTime))
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'TruthCondFoil', 'Task'. You can override
## using the `.groups` argument.
print(agr)

Total RT with median and mode stats

horizontal format

agr <- sc %>%
    group_by(Valence,Task,Word) %>%
    summarize(MeanReactionTime = mean(LogReactionTime), 
              CILow = ci.low(LogReactionTime), 
              CIHigh = ci.high(ReactionTime)) %>%
    mutate(YMin = MeanReactionTime - CILow, 
           YMax = MeanReactionTime + CIHigh)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'Valence', 'Task'. You can override using
## the `.groups` argument.
agr$Task <- ifelse(agr$Task == "Valence", "Valence", "TruthCond")
agr$Task <- factor(agr$Task, levels = c("TruthCond","Valence"))

# Set dodge width to match violin grouping
dodge_width <- 0.9

ggplot(agr, aes(x = Task, y = MeanReactionTime, fill = Valence)) + 
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.4, position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +

  # Add mean point with matching dodge
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "point",
               shape = 23,
               size = 2,
               position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  stat_summary(fun = median,
                geom = "crossbar",
                width = 0.3, 
                linewidth = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = dodge_width)) +
  
  labs(y = "Mean Reaction Time", x = "Valence") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 10)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    axis.title.x=element_blank(),
    text = element_text(family = "Helvetica"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),     # x-axis title
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12),     # y-axis ticks
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12),     # x-axis ticks
  )

Model

Similarity Judgment Experiments

names(sj)
## [1] "...1"             "WordPair"         "ID.true"          "TruthCondFoil"   
## [5] "SimilarityRating" "Valence"          "Conceptual"       "FeatureMatch"    
## [9] "ExperimentType"
sj$TruthCondFoil <- as.factor(sj$TruthCondFoil)
agr <- sj %>%
  filter(FeatureMatch == "ValenceMatchingOnly") %>% 
    group_by(TruthCondFoil,Valence,WordPair) %>%
    summarize(MeanSimilarity = mean(SimilarityRating), 
              CILow = ci.low(SimilarityRating), 
              CIHigh = ci.high(SimilarityRating)) %>%
    mutate(YMin = MeanSimilarity - CILow, 
           YMax = MeanSimilarity + CIHigh)
## `summarise()` has grouped output by 'TruthCondFoil', 'Valence'. You can
## override using the `.groups` argument.

    # facet_wrap(

  # Add mean point with matching dodge

  stat_summary(fun = median,
                geom = "crossbar",

  theme(

# ggsave("../graphs/total_rt_paper2.jpg",width = 6, height = 3)
sj$Valence <- as.factor(sj$Valence)
contrasts(sj$Valence)
##                  NegativeMismatch PositiveMatch PositiveMismatch
## NegativeMatch                   0             0                0
## NegativeMismatch                1             0                0
## PositiveMatch                   0             1                0
## PositiveMismatch                0             0                1
names(sj)
## [1] "...1"             "WordPair"         "ID.true"          "TruthCondFoil"   
## [5] "SimilarityRating" "Valence"          "Conceptual"       "FeatureMatch"    
## [9] "ExperimentType"
center <- sj %>% 
  filter(FeatureMatch == "ValenceMatchingOnly") %>% 
  mutate(cValence = as.numeric(Valence)-mean(as.numeric(Valence)),
         WordPair = as.factor(WordPair),
         ID.true = as.factor(ID.true)
         ) %>% 
  drop_na()



m <- lmer(SimilarityRating ~ cValence*TruthCondFoil + (1|WordPair) + (1+cValence|ID.true), data = center)
summary(m)
## Linear mixed model fit by REML. t-tests use Satterthwaite's method [
## lmerModLmerTest]
## Formula: SimilarityRating ~ cValence * TruthCondFoil + (1 | WordPair) +  
##     (1 + cValence | ID.true)
